sloka: रक्ताक्षाः सुमहाकाया नीलाञ्जनचयोपमाः।शूलानुद्यम्य खड्गांश्च निशितांश्च परश्वधान् ।। ६.६५.३९ ।।
transliteration: raktākṣāḥ sumahākāyā nīlāñjanacayopamāḥ।śūlānudyamya khaḍgāṁśca niśitāṁśca paraśvadhān ।। 6.65.39 ।।

translations.english: Rakshasas with blood red eyes, of huge body size, dark blue in colour, holding tridents, sharpened whetted axes and weapons of many kinds, iron bars and maces, clubs, mallets and palmyra trees, the evil minded vast army set out.
